title: Grand Fantasy City
body: Deep metropolitan archetype covering districts, civic leadership, trade guilds, architecture, defenses, and hidden urban currents.

sampleValues.Signature Skyline & Atmosphere: Terraced limestone towers linked by copper cableways, smelling of sea-salt, roasted cardamom, and ozone from the storm-spires.
sampleValues.Major Districts:
High Astrolabe | Scholarly spires | Observatory of Tides
Sunken Wharf | Bustling & briny | The Barnacle Exchange
Ashen Kilns | Industrial | Glassblower Commons
sampleValues.Wonders & Sacred Sites: The Tidegate Bridge—an ancient basalt arch that seals itself with runes during winter gales.
sampleValues.Unusual Civic Laws: Open flame is forbidden on the lower timber docks after the third bell; dueling is legal only on the Salt Flats at low tide.
sampleValues.Currency & Tax Customs: Silver Tide-Marks; 4% anchor levy on foreign hulls
sampleValues.Walls, Wards & Garrison: Three-tiered sea bastions manned by the Stormwatch Marines and lightning-rod ward pylons.
sampleValues.Black Market & Secrets: Flooded smugglers' cisterns beneath Sunken Wharf connect directly to the vaults of the Glassblower Commons.
